privacy.protection_preset.description: Balanced is the default. Strict can reduce website compatibility.
privacy.fingerprint.description: Standardizes selected high-entropy APIs without per-call randomization.
privacy.anti_fingerprinting.title: Fingerprint protection
privacy.anti_fingerprinting.description: Current effective categories are summarized here. Tor and Onion keep mandatory protections enabled.
privacy.webrtc.description: Keeps non-proxied UDP disabled and follows the active private-route policy. Turning it off blocks the API; Tor and Onion always block it.
privacy.trackers.description: Blocks compiled tracker and cryptomining host rules without remote checks.
privacy.third_party_cookies.description: Rejects third-party cookie access unless a site rule allows it.
privacy.referrer.description: Sends only the origin on cross-origin requests.
privacy.gpc.description: Sends Sec-GPC: 1 as a privacy preference signal.
privacy.dnt.description: Sends the optional DNT signal; websites may ignore it.
privacy.clear_cookies_exit.description: Removes Normal-profile cookies when Granger Browser closes.
privacy.clear_cache_exit.description: Clears the Normal-profile HTTP cache when Granger Browser closes.
privacy.clear_storage_exit.description: Deletes normal-profile local storage, IndexedDB, service workers and related databases before the next startup.
privacy.tor_isolation.description: Required safety invariant: Tor browsing uses a separate memory-only WebEngine profile.
privacy.clear_tor_disconnect.description: Clears Tor and Onion memory stores when the route is ended.
privacy.block_fallback.description: Required safety invariant: navigation stops while a selected Tor route is unverified.
privacy.disable_webrtc_tor.description: Required safety invariant because Qt WebEngine cannot guarantee WebRTC over SOCKS/Tor.
privacy.onion_isolation.description: Required safety invariant: .onion pages use a separate memory-only identity.
privacy.javascript.description: JavaScript stays enabled by default; high-risk APIs are controlled separately.
privacy.popups.description: Blocks script-created windows unless a site rule allows them.
privacy.prefetch.description: Stops DNS prefetch and speculative resource requests.
privacy.strip_tracking.description: Removes known campaign identifiers from top-level GET navigations.
privacy.script_control.description: Control first-party JavaScript separately from third-party scripts, frames and WebAssembly.
privacy.third_party_scripts.description: Blocks script resources whose registrable domain differs from the site.
privacy.third_party_frames.description: Blocks cross-site iframe resources while leaving first-party frames available.
privacy.webassembly.description: Disables the WebAssembly API for sites unless a site rule allows it.
privacy.link_cleaning.description: Uses one deterministic local policy and never sends links to an external service.
privacy.redirect_protection.description: Locally opens known redirect wrappers without making an analysis request.
privacy.graphical_api_protection.descrip: Protects Canvas, OffscreenCanvas and WebGL fingerprinting surfaces.
privacy.strict_warning: Stronger privacy may reduce website compatibility.
privacy.active_profile.description: The selected configuration is applied to existing and new tabs where supported.
privacy.site_rules.description: Origin rules match an exact scheme, host and port. Domain rules match the domain and its subdomains.

pamp.finding.http.title: Unencrypted HTTP transport
pamp.finding.http.evidence: The loaded page uses HTTP rather than HTTPS.
pamp.finding.http.recommendation: Serve the page through HTTPS and redirect HTTP requests.
pamp.finding.certificate.title: Certificate validation problem
pamp.finding.certificate.recommendation: Correct the certificate chain, host identity or validity period before users proceed.
pamp.finding.hsts.title: HSTS header is absent
pamp.finding.hsts.evidence: No Strict-Transport-Security response header was observed.
pamp.finding.hsts.recommendation: Publish a scoped HSTS policy after confirming HTTPS coverage.
pamp.finding.csp.title: Content Security Policy is absent
pamp.finding.csp.evidence: No Content-Security-Policy response header was observed.
pamp.finding.csp.recommendation: Deploy a tested CSP and tighten script, frame and object sources incrementally.
pamp.finding.nosniff.title: MIME sniffing protection is absent
pamp.finding.framing.title: No framing restriction was observed
pamp.finding.framing.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was observed.
pamp.finding.permissions.title: Permissions Policy is absent
pamp.finding.permissions.evidence: No Permissions-Policy response header was observed.
pamp.finding.permissions.recommendation: Restrict sensitive browser features that the site does not use.
pamp.finding.technology.title: Server technology metadata is exposed
pamp.finding.technology.recommendation: Remove unnecessary version or framework disclosure where practical.
pamp.finding.third_party_large.title: Large third-party resource surface
pamp.finding.third_party_large.recommend: Review required third parties and remove or isolate unnecessary dependencies.
pamp.finding.third_party.title: Third-party resources are present
pamp.finding.third_party.recommendation: Verify the purpose and data flow of each external dependency.
pamp.finding.fingerprint.title: Fingerprint-relevant browser surfaces are exposed to the page
pamp.finding.fingerprint.recommendation: Interpret this as capability exposure, not proof that the page used every API.
pamp.finding.http_status.title: The server returned an error response
pamp.finding.http_status.recommendation: Review server logs and availability without weakening browser protections.
pamp.finding.referrer.title: Referrer Policy is absent
pamp.finding.referrer.evidence: No Referrer-Policy response header was observed.
pamp.finding.referrer.recommendation: Define a policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin that matches the application.
pamp.finding.mixed_content.title: Mixed-content resources were observed
pamp.finding.mixed_content.evidence: %1 HTTP resources appeared in the HTTPS page snapshot.
pamp.finding.mixed_content.recommendatio: Serve every required resource over HTTPS and remove insecure dependencies.
pamp.finding.secure_context.title: The page was not exposed as a secure context
pamp.finding.secure_context.evidence: The browser reported isSecureContext=false for an HTTPS page.
pamp.finding.secure_context.recommendati: Review certificate, embedding and mixed-content conditions.
pamp.finding.cookie_secure.title: Cookies without Secure were observed
pamp.finding.cookie_secure.evidence: %1 cookie metadata records lacked the Secure flag on an HTTPS site.
pamp.finding.cookie_secure.recommendatio: Mark authentication and sensitive cookies Secure.
pamp.finding.cookie_http_only.title: Script-readable cookies were observed
pamp.finding.cookie_http_only.recommenda: Use HttpOnly for cookies that client-side scripts do not need.
pamp.finding.redirects.title: Long redirect chain
pamp.finding.redirects.evidence: The loaded navigation recorded %1 redirect steps.
pamp.finding.redirects.recommendation: Remove unnecessary redirects and verify every cross-domain transition.
